description: Local user model-profile. Edited by the user (or by install.sh) to point the five logical tier tokens at concrete provider/model IDs. Agent frontmatter references logical tiers ({{TIER_ROUTER}}, {{TIER_REASONING}}, {{TIER_CODE}}, {{TIER_FAST}}, {{TIER_REVIEW}}) instead of hardcoded model IDs; install.sh / scripts/apply-model-preset.py resolve tokens to concrete provider/model IDs at install time using the preset selected below. This file is user-local and gitignored.

tiers.TIER_REASONING: Deep reasoning / architecture / orchestration — used by oracle, security, planner. Required.
tiers.TIER_CODE: Implementation, code authoring, and test-writing — used by developer-fixer and test-engineer. Required.
tiers.TIER_FAST: Lightweight utility and high-throughput tasks — used by profiler, explorer, librarian, build-helper, npm-helper, deploy-helper, pc-doctor, writer. Required.
tiers.TIER_REVIEW: General correctness / quality review — used by code-reviewer. Falls back to TIER_CODE when omitted.

default.label: OpenCode Go + Ollama Cloud (default)
default.description: Known-good default profile mirroring the kit's out-of-the-box behavior: a flagship reasoning model, cloud-hosted specialists for code and review, and a fast cloud model for utility tasks.

opencode-go.label: OpenCode Go (legacy alias of `default`)
opencode-go.description: Backward-compatible alias of the `default` preset. Retained so older install commands and migration scripts that target `--preset opencode-go` keep working.

three-tier-legacy.label: Three-tier legacy preset (backward-compat fixture)
three-tier-legacy.description: Declares only the original three required tiers (TIER_REASONING, TIER_CODE, TIER_FAST). TIER_ROUTER and TIER_REVIEW must resolve through their one-hop fallbacks (TIER_ROUTER -> TIER_REASONING, TIER_REVIEW -> TIER_CODE). Used to exercise the fallback path in tests.
